blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Firefighters rescued a 17-year-old teenager who fell about 15 meters down a cliff in Upper Irisan here early Saturday, the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) said. Personnel from the Baguio City Fire Station responded to the incident near Dragon Treasure Castle in Phase 2, Irisville Subdivision, Purok 20, at 12:19 a.m. Working with the police, Baguio City Emergency Medical Services (BCEMS) and barangay officials, firefighters administered first aid and set up a rope rescue system to rescue the teenager.
